m: प्र-√ तुद् P. -तुदति, to strike at, cut through, pierce, MBh.; Hariv.; BhP. : Caus. -तोदयति, to push on, urge, instigate, MBh.; Mṛcch.
प्र-˚तुद् m. ‘pecker’, N. of a class of birds (including the falcon, hawk, owl, parrot, crow, raven, peacock &c.), Āpast.
a: प्रतुद् — {c6c} P. To strike, hurt, wound. --Caus. 1 To urge on, drive forward; (fig.) to press, urge repeatedly (to do a thing); प्रविश गृहमिति प्रतोद्यप्ताना न चलति भाग्यकृतां दशामवेक्ष्य Mk. 1. 56. --2 To pierce, cut.

m: प्र-˚तुद m. id., Gaut.; Mn.; Yājñ.; Suśr.
a: प्रतुदः — 1 An epithet of a class of birds (such as hawks, parrots, crows &c.). --2 An instrument for pricking.

m: प्र-√ तुर्व् (only pr. p. -तूर्वत्), to be victorious, RV. v, 65, 4.
प्र-√ तुष् P. -तुष्यति, to delight in (instr.), Bhaṭṭ. : Caus. -तोषयति, to give pleasure, gratify, BhP.
प्र-˚तुष्टि f. satisfaction (-द mfn. giving s˚), Pañcat.
प्र-तुष्टुषु mfn. (fr. Desid.) wishing to praise, W.
